notes: Three independent service layers (StatementService, OutstandingCalculator, StatementNarrator) each call CustomerRepository.findProfile, an aggregate over customer_payment, not a cheap PK read. The outcome this scenario actually tests is derive_scope's repeated_callers() expansion, not an approach label: the three call sites are siblings, not a linear chain, so a candidate naming any ONE of them must still end up scoped to all three, or the gate's own diff_minimality check fails on exactly the site a partial scope omitted (which is what happened the first time this scenario ran for real, STM-01's own patch.json). files_to_touch_contains asserts the sibling StatementNarrator.java is in the SELECTED candidate's scope regardless of which of its two siblings the candidate's own approach is framed around. mechanism_any_of allows both sql_count and rows_examined: the live run that actually shipped this PR chose a different cheap-existence-check-plus-direct-sum fix than literally sharing one fetch across all three calls, moving rows_examined (2,002,594 -> 1,405,494) with sql_count unchanged (72 -> 72) -- a legitimate alternative remedy for the same redundancy, not a misclassification, so both mechanisms are accepted here rather than re-narrowed on every re-sample.
